_meta.purpose: Bikes on the “Showcase” page (showcase.html): bikes the brands call new (tagged “New”) plus bikes available now from Canadian sellers. Every entry has a live Canadian product page and a photo of at least 1000px.
rules: Never add a bike without opening its product page and confirming the brand calls it new.
Photos are linked from the brand’s own site (never copied). Verify with scripts/verify-showcase.mjs.
Skip any model with a recall notice, a 404, or only a placeholder/banner image.
Prices are the brand’s “from” price in CAD on the day it was checked, shown only if verified.

skipped.why: Health Canada has a crank recall for these model names (2020–2022 model years), and we couldn’t confirm the listed bikes are a newer year.
Norco issued a voluntary safety recall on all 2027 Fluid Gen 3 models; not featured.

skipped.what: Canyon Spectral:ON CF 9 and other Canyon launches
skipped.why: Only a “coming soon” page with no product page to link to as of 2026-11-12.
Trek’s new-bikes pages are script-rendered and returned only banner images; add by hand once product pages and photos can be verified.
Product page returns 404 on Giant Canada.

skipped.what: Priority, Guardian, Aventon, Ride1Up, Tumbleweed and Quintana Roo
skipped.why: These sell only in the US, so we can’t say you can buy them in Canada.

skipped.what: Brands without a verified Canadian product page yet
skipped.why: Trek, Cervélo, Canyon, Scott, Santa Cruz and others aren’t listed until we can check their Canadian pages and photos.
